name: Newspaper Spin
blurb: Old-movie front pages as an ACCENT: at most two pages (the hook, and one more after >= 2 full-frame lines), each <= 2 lines / 4.6 s, headline + highlighter + colour photo changing on the page (text columns where a line has no clip, never a dark box); every other line is FULL-FRAME B-roll with tall condensed caps over smoke; a store-listing card only on a store/price line after the turn that does not knock other resellers.
